page.layout: One printed page (right-hand side of the opening), table of contents. Heading at top centre; below it a list of numbered lines in two columns of text (roman numeral, then entry, with wrapped continuation lines). Handwritten pencil numbers at lower centre are not printed.
page.head: IN MISCELLANEIS CATECHETICIS continentur sequentia capita.
page.l: I. Aphorismi doctrinæ Ecclesiarum reformatarum, præcipuos Articulos Religionis Christianæ complectentes.
II. Thema sæculare de Papatu Romano.
III. Symbolum B. Athanasii. Cum Notis Parei.
IV. Symbolum Patrum Antiochenorum aduersus Paulum Samosatenum.
V. Quæstio: An Deus omnes homines sub conditione seruatæ legis vno fine condiderit in Adamo ad salutem.
VI. In ThesES D. Ægidii Hvnnii De vnione personali animæ aduersiones.
VII. Conciliatio controuersiæ de Iustitia CHRISTI actiua & passiua.
VIII. Fragmentum Orationis de fructu mortis Christi.
X. Epitome Arminianismi: siue, Examen quinq; articulorum Ministrorum Remonstrantium in Belgio.
page.notes: Pencil annotations below the list ("3" over "5892 (2") are handwriting and are omitted. The entry in VI reads as printed "ThesES" in the scan; the line "In Theses D. Ægidii Hvnnii De vnione personali animæ aduersiones" is taken as printed, with the word "animæ" possibly "animae" printed with a hyphen break ("anim-/aduersiones"). Line VI is uncertain at "ThesES" [?].
